primary_citation.popular_name: Fraud and related activity in connection with identification documents, authentication features, and information (Federal Identity Theft Statute)
primary_citation.original_enactment: Pub. L. 97-398, False Identification Crime Control Act of 1982
significant_amendments: Pub. L. 105-318 (1998) — ITADA, added 'means of identification' concept and subsection (a)(7)
Pub. L. 108-275 (2004) — ITPEA, added §1028A aggravated identity theft
Pub. L. 110-326 (2008) — Identity Theft Enforcement and Restitution Act, restitution expansion

interpretive.rule: §1028A requires proof defendant knew the means of identification belonged to a real person
§1028A requires the identity theft to be 'at the crux' of the underlying fraud, not incidental

operational_notes_for_steward_cases.pleading_framework: Map facts to §1028(a)(7) 'means of identification' prohibition + §1028A predicate felony (wire fraud §1343, bank fraud §1344, false statements §1001, theft of government property §641). Prepare criminal-referral package with §1028A exposure analysis; plead civil RICO under §1961(1)(B)/§1964(c); plead FCRA §1681c-2 identity theft block in parallel.
operational_notes_for_steward_cases.federal_nexus: Satisfied automatically for SSN-based cases via 'issued by the United States' prong of §1028(c)(3)(A); interstate commerce showing not required.
